mechanism: Foscarnet can cause electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) and renal impairment that may alter lamotrigine metabolism and increase CNS toxicity risk.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and lamotrigine levels; adjust lamotrigine dose if renal function declines; assess for lamotrigine toxicity symptoms (tremor, ataxia, diplopia).
